proposed_widenings.name: catalog_ref summon payload for magic-item spawned creature
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item summon family only accepts an inline stat block, but this item summons a named existing monster and adds item-specific control and dismissal rules on top of that catalog creature.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Magic action to summon an Air Elemental

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall. The item fits the existing magic-item summon family at a high level, but not honestly with the current inline-only statBlock payload because the source text names an external monster stat block rather than providing one inline.
